description:
Full detail for one order: line items, payment + fulfillment status, shipments/tracking, and `ship_by_at` (the sales channel's ship-by deadline, UTC) when the channel has one. If `needs_attention` is present the order will not complete on its own; tell the user its `title` and `message`. When its `kind` is `provider_failed`, `reason` is the provider's own words (e.g. "No payment method added") and the order reads `fulfillment_status` cancelled with `status` failed: not an ordinary cancellation. If `recovery_action` is `resubmit_to_fulfillment`, have the merchant fix the cause on their provider account, then call submit_order_to_fulfillment (or confirm_order) on this SAME order; it re-confirms the existing provider order, never a second one, so nothing is charged twice. If `recovery_action` is null nothing at the provider can be resubmitted and a new order is needed. An order the merchant cancelled after a provider failure has `needs_attention` null and cannot be resubmitted. `cost` and `profit` are this order's own figures once the provider has priced it. If `checkout_split` is present, the buyer's checkout was split into `checkout_split.order_count` orders across the merchant's stores and this order holds only its share: when asked how the sale did, report `checkout_split.profit` (the whole checkout), and never add it up across the orders in the split. If `hold_details.code` is `destination_unsupported`, the order is going to `hold_details.country`, which its provider (`hold_details.provider_name`, delivering only to `hold_details.ships_to`) cannot reach, so it was never sent for printing and the provider has not charged the merchant. Tell the user `hold_details.message`. If `hold_details.suggested_reroute` is set, offer to move the order to that product with reroute_order; if it is null, no move is allowed and the merchant should cancel the order and refund the customer on their storefront. The held lines are the items whose product_variant_id is in `hold_details.product_variant_ids`. Read-only.

title: Get order details
